Usage: resecta-data build g8-bucket-recall [OPTIONS]

  Build the G8 bucket-stratified recall artifact.

  Reads the G8 corpus and the surnames Bloom filter from ``build_dir`` and emits
  ``demographics/g8_bucket_recall_v1.json``. A one-off measurement (point estimate + sample size
  only).

Options:
  --build-dir DIRECTORY  [required]
  --seed INTEGER         [default: 20260416]
  --help                 Show this message and exit.
